subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Scam Call Centers Operate
description: A quick win: understand How Scam Call Centers Operate.

hook.text: In some countries, scam call centers operate in office buildings with hundreds of employees.

buildup.text: Workers follow scripts, track 'leads,' and earn commissions — like a twisted sales office.

discovery.text: They use VoIP to display fake caller IDs, making calls appear to come from local numbers.

twist.text: Some call center workers are victims themselves — trafficked and forced to scam under threat.

climax.text: Scam call centers are now a global industry generating billions in stolen funds annually.

punchline.text: It looks like a call center because it is one — for crime.

quiz.question: How do scam call centers disguise their location?
options: They use VoIP to display fake local caller IDs
